previous_statement: For the successor raw call u_2 supplied and certified in node 1.2.3.1, apply lem-maincb-reset-output-typing alone with D=D_*, t=t_2, epsilon_R=W.L*epsilon, B_R=M_{r+1}, and A_R=A_{U_{r+1}}. Select the single existential output v_{U_{r+1}} of that lemma. Since u_2 is bijective, this same output is an extended W.c0_cb*epsilon_R-isomorphism; the same conclusion gives d_{U_{r+1}} <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_R, ||v_{U_{r+1}}(I_{M_{r+1}})-u_{A_{U_{r+1}}}|| <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_R, and unchanged source, target, and amplification form. With the recorded field epsilon_{U_{r+1}}:=epsilon_R=W.L*epsilon, these data form the required successor def-maincb-reset-state. No witness from lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation is used or identified with this witness.
new_statement: Before invoking lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger, choose one common reset-constant tuple that is simultaneously admissible for lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation and lem-maincb-reset-output-typing: take the maximum of their two positive finite C_unit witnesses and the coordinatewise minima of their two positive epsilon_unit, delta_unit, and a_unit witnesses. Monotonicity of the displayed guards makes this common tuple a witness for both lemmas, and the ledger is instantiated with it as a valid reset-invariant witness. Hence the fixed W supplied by that ledger satisfies the W-guards of lem-maincb-reset-output-typing for D=D_*. For the successor raw call u_2 certified in node 1.2.3.1, apply lem-maincb-reset-output-typing with t=t_2, epsilon_R=W.L*epsilon, B_R=M_{r+1}, and A_R=A_{U_{r+1}}, and select its single output v_{U_{r+1}}. Since u_2 is bijective, the conclusion makes this output an extended W.c0_cb*epsilon_R-isomorphism, gives d_{U_{r+1}} <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_R and ||v_{U_{r+1}}(I_{M_{r+1}})-u_{A_{U_{r+1}}}|| <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_R, and preserves source, target, and amplification form. With epsilon_{U_{r+1}}:=epsilon_R=W.L*epsilon, these data form the required successor def-maincb-reset-state.
